title: Every IVUS Frame in Its Place: A Zero-Install Browser Tool for Registering Intravascular Ultrasound to the Coronary Angiogram, and a Path to Angiography-Only Plaque Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.28089v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) shows plaque composition, calcium and stent apposition that the coronary angiogram cannot, but relating each IVUS cross-section to its position on the angiogram is still largely done in the operator's head. Commercial co-registration is tied to vendor consoles and to set-up at acquisition, so archived angiograms and pullbacks cannot be co-registered, and paired data for training AI models remain scarce. We present a semi-automatic registration tool that runs entirely in a web browser, with no installation and no upload. The clinician picks a contrast-filled reference frame (aided by automatic contrast and cardiac-phase analysis), selects or traces the vessel centerline (aided by Frangi vesselness and minimal paths), and pins the pullback ends and visible landmarks; a monotone piecewise-linear map then places every IVUS frame on the vessel, and each case exports as a frame-level training record. translated_title: 每个IVUS帧各就其位：一种将血管内超声配准到冠状动脉造影的零安装浏览器工具，以及迈向仅凭造影进行斑块成像的路径
translated_abstract: 血管内超声（IVUS）能够显示冠状动脉造影无法显示的斑块成分、钙化和支架贴壁情况，但将每个IVUS横截面与造影图像上的位置相关联，目前仍主要依靠操作者头脑中的判断。商用的共同配准系统绑定于厂商工作站和采集时的设置，因此存档的造影图像和回撤图像无法进行配准，用于训练AI模型的配对数据依然稀缺。我们提出了一种完全在网页浏览器中运行的半自动配准工具，无需安装、无需上传。临床医生选择一个造影剂充盈的参考帧（借助自动造影剂和心脏时相分析辅助），选择或描记血管中心线（借助Frangi血管性滤波与最小路径方法），并标记回撤的起止点和可见的解剖标志；随后通过单调分段线性映射将每个IVUS帧定位到血管上，每个病例可导出为帧级训练记录。原文在此处被截断。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种零安装、纯浏览器运行的半自动IVUS-冠脉造影配准工具，可将每个IVUS帧定位到造影血管上并导出帧级训练记录，为仅凭造影实现斑块成像和AI模型训练数据的积累开辟了道路。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a zero-install, browser-based semi-automatic tool that registers every IVUS frame onto the coronary angiogram and exports frame-level training records, paving the way toward angiography-only plaque imaging and AI training data accumulation.
